# Copilot Instructions for commaKit

Use the shared agent directives for this repository.

1. Read the repository root `AGENTS.md`.
2. Read the nearest `AGENTS.md` for any directory you edit.
3. Use `dev/knowledge/index.md` for durable project knowledge.
4. Use `dev/knowledge/architecture.md` for package architecture and API contracts.
5. Use `dev/knowledge/project-status.md` for current package/test inventory.

Do not duplicate package facts here. If a durable fact changes, update the shared `AGENTS.md` hierarchy or the relevant `dev/knowledge/` card.
